mcp_server_unrestricted.title: Hermes can control locks and doors
mcp_server_unrestricted.description:
The Model Context Protocol Server is not serving "{api_name}", so anything connected to it — including Hermes — gets the unrestricted Assist tools and can lock, unlock, open and close your doors.

To restrict it, open the Model Context Protocol Server integration, reconfigure it, and select "{api_name}".

Ignore this if you intend that client to have full control.

profile_ignored.title: Hermes is ignoring the profile name
profile_ignored.description:
Hermes is not routing on the profile prefix, so requests meant for "{profile}" are being served by the gateway's default profile instead. Nothing fails — the agent simply answers as the wrong persona.

Set `gateway.multiplex_profiles: true` in the Hermes gateway config and restart it. If you run a single-profile gateway on purpose, this warning is expected and can be ignored.
